summary: bkit workflow friction optimisation — BAR-155
description: Six-fix follow-up to BAR-137 (stub-first verdict-artifact pattern) addressing recurring `.agents/` workflow friction observed 2026-05-06 → 2026-05-08. **Fix 1b:** `echo {finding} >> {output}` incremental-append and eager `Verdict:` flip-on-FAIL extended from `bkit-build-plan-execute` to `bkit-build-challenge-1`, `-2`, `bkit-build-plan-verify`, `bkit-build-challenge-tests` — eliminates silent `Verdict: PENDING` artifacts on freeform-reviewer budget exhaustion. Audit-pass classified all 8 utility-audit prompts as (b) stubbed verdict-bearing (no Fix-1b edits required); classification record at `docs/plans/202605/logs/.../utility-audit-classification.md`. **Fix 2:** `bkit-plan.md` Step 8 deterministic task-count gate (`grep -cE '^- \[ \] \*\*Task' plan-v3-checked.md` → SPLIT if >15, no LLM judgement); `bkit-plan-complexity-check.md` Verdict mapping extended `SPLIT = >100K tokens OR TASK_COUNT > 15`. **Fix 3:** `bkit-plan.md` Step 3 scoped multi-issue refusal (`awk '/^## Linear Issue:/{flag=1; next} /^## /{flag=0} flag' | grep -oE 'BAR-[0-9]+' | sort -u | wc -l` → Failure Path if >1) — counts BAR-N tokens only inside the `## Linear Issue:` section, not prose mentions. **Fix 4a–d:** Single `bkit-build-challenge.md` DELETED, replaced by parallel pair `bkit-build-challenge-1.md` (Opus/high) and `bkit-build-challenge-2.md` (Sonnet/medium) with `Parallel:` circular-reasoning guard, plus `bkit-build-challenge-reconcile.md` reconciler (Opus/xhigh, maxTurns 30) — fresh-skeleton `Write` (NOT `cp`) prevents duplicate `Verdict:`, dedup heuristic = same `file:line` OR same root-cause cluster, severity tie-break max-wins on canonical challenge ladder `CRITICAL > HIGH > MEDIUM > LOW`, verdict tie-break max-wins on `FAIL > CONCERNS > PASS`, downgrade only with explicit `## Justification` block. NO `BLOCK` / `WARN` terminology (canonical challenge ladder only). `bkit-build.md` Steps 9–18 wired: Step 9 launches both challenges in parallel, NEW Step 10 reconciles, former Steps 10–17 renumbered to 11–18; `CHALLENGE_VERDICT` extraction moved from old Step 9 → new Step 10; `CHALLENGE_REMEDIATE_ATTEMPT` counter persists across `Re-run Step 9` re-entries (NOT reset). **Fix 5:** `bkit-ship.md` Step 2 bare `git rebase origin/dev || exit 1` → sentinel-file Failure Path routing (`if ! git rebase ...; then git rebase --abort; touch {FID}/.rebase-failed; fi` inside the same bash block; prose sub-step 3a checks sentinel; Failure Path Step 4 condition broadened to include sentinel presence so `bkit-debug-abort-handover` fires for rebase aborts). `REBASE_FAILED` env-var pattern explicitly rejected (bash-block scope does not survive across orchestrator boundaries; sentinel file is canonical inter-block signal). Stale-sentinel cleanup `rm -f .rebase-failed` brackets the write at retry start AND Failure Path exit (per KN-15). **Fix 6:** `bkit-build.md` Step 1 always-on long-branch advisory `[bkit-build] feature branch is N commits behind dev / M ago since divergence` (`git rev-list --count HEAD..origin/dev` and `git show -s --format=%ar $(git merge-base ...)`); no thresholds, no Failure Path on advisory — pure stdout signal. **Index docs synced:** `.bkit/docs/prompts.md` Models / Effort tiers / Tool set patterns / maxTurns / Special Behaviors tables drop `bkit-build-challenge`, add three new rows; `.bkit/docs/workflows.md` Build Phase row pattern mirrors Design Phase parallel-pair and reconciler shape; `.agents/friction.md` 5 retained 2026-05-06 → 2026-05-08 entries marked `FIXED-IN: BAR-155` (Status line only — friction § Rules forbid editing `Description` / `Suggested fix`). **Build challenge surfaced 12 findings (3 HIGH, 5 MEDIUM, 2 LOW, 2 architectural — all remediated):** HIGH-1 sentinel `touch` before `mkdir -p` could fail silently on missing FID logs dir (KN-15 cleanup pattern); HIGH-2 `bkit-build-plan-verify.md` `## Gaps Identified` was middle section so Fix-1b EOF append landed in `## Notes` (KN-16 — append-target section MUST be last); HIGH-3 stale gate-checkpoint step references after renumber (Steps 13–16 → 14–17 across 10 cross-refs). **Tests:** 39 regression tests added in `.agents/scripts/bar-155-regression.test.ts` covering sentinel mkdir-p ordering, plan-verify section ordering, gate checkpoint step refs, long-branch advisory shell pattern, sentinel cleanup, SC-4/SC-5 invariants, BLOCK/WARN absence, parallel-pair invariants, deleted-file guard, Fix 1b directive presence; all pass. **Ship cycle:** Step 2 bare `git rebase` failed with `docs/pending.md` conflict at commit `880921c` despite branch already containing full origin/dev history via merge commit `4725094`; manual switch to `git rebase --rebase-merges` succeeded 50/50. New friction entry filed (`bkit-ship Step 2 bare git rebase fails on branches with merge commits`, Status `OPEN`) tracking BAR-169 as the active follow-up — the Fix 5 sentinel routing landed correctly but the bare `git rebase` command itself remains an anti-pattern for merge-integrated branches.

description: Eliminated ~50 commits and ~10 dev pushes per typical workflow run. summary: bkit tracker pluggability — github/linear/none provider abstraction — #39
description: Lands the foundational substitution mechanism and workflow rewrite for the Linear→GitHub tracker migration. `.bkit/docs/trackers.md` defines three providers (`github` / `linear` / `none`); workflows carry `<!-- bkit:tracker {id} start --> ... end -->` marker pairs at every tracker call site; `bkit install --tracker=<name>` writes the manifest field, merges `mcpServers.<name>` into `.mcp.json` (+ Cursor variant), and substitutes provider snippets into mirror output (zero markers in `.claude/commands/*` / `.cursor/commands/*`). Substitution counts verified across all 6 workflows × 3 trackers (build 31, design 23, plan 19, ship 21, debug 23, ci-router 9; no missing, no orphans). **Uniform new-comment-per-step semantics** across providers — Linear loses edit-in-place rule for parity with GitHub-MCP capabilities (`mcp__linear__save_comment` and `mcp__github__add_issue_comment` both create new comments per step; no `COMMENT_ID` tracking). **Label vocabulary** rewritten to `bkit:design|plan|build|debug|ship|merged` (phase, mutually exclusive) and `bkit:auto|failed|debug` (additive). **AGENTS.md cross-host router** accepts `#NNN` (GitHub), `[A-Z]+-\d+` (Linear/prefixed), and bare `\d+` (GitHub fallback). **PR body metadata marker** `<!-- bkit:issue=#NNN bkit:fid=NNN-slug bkit:auto -->` written at PR creation; downstream debug/ship/ci-router workflows resolve issue ID via `mcp__github__pull_request_read`. **Marker namespacing**: bkit-emitted commits prepend `bkit ` for attribution (`bkit [skip ci]`, `bkit [verbose ci]` etc.); CHECK sites in `ci.yml` and workflows match bare substring so user-typed markers still trigger. **Out of scope (follow-on)**: CI-router double-gate runtime, Cursor cloud dispatch docs, `BAR-` → `ISSUE-` doc sweep, full dogfood Design→Ship cycle.

summary: CI-Dispatch Gate — outcome-based verification of the final loud push — #261
description: Replaced the string-only **HEAD-Subject Assertion** safeguard with an **outcome-based CI-Dispatch gate** that, after a build / debug workflow's final loud push, confirms a `bkit-decide` run was actually dispatched for the exact pushed HEAD — closing the KN-11 vacuously-green-PR gap (PR HEAD carries `[skip ci]` → empty `statusCheckRollup` → fail-fast gates admit an untested PR). The gate polls `gh pr view --json statusCheckRollup` (fuzzy `test("decide"; "i")` — decide may be consumer-renamed) every `POLL_INTERVAL_S=10`s up to `POLL_BUDGET_S=60`s (ATTEMPTS=6), logging each iteration with the `[bkit-ci-gate]` prefix; on empty-budget and clean HEAD it self-heals **once** (cap=1) with a clean empty `re-trigger` commit, re-polls, then terminates with a named verdict in a 4-outcome state machine — `dispatched` / `self-healed` / `no-ci` (logged pass — consumer has no CI workflow for the event) / `unresolved` (→ Failure Path). Sub-reason codes `timeout-dirty` / `retrigger-suppressed` / `autoroute-mismatch` / `gh-error` discriminate the `unresolved` paths. Verdict is always written to the per-FID `status.jsonl` `step-done` record via the **additive** `ciDispatch` object (`{outcome, head, attempts, retrigger}` and optional `reason`) — backward-compatible with the #209 FOLD reducer (`del(.type,.workflow)` and merge preserves unknown keys). **Authoring-only:** the gate kernel is appended inline at **2 sites, not 3** — build Step 18 close-workflow, debug Step 10 (PR-mode close-workflow sub-step 3 and LOCAL-mode create-pr sub-step 9); **ship is OUT** (its existing `SQUASH_SHA`-poll gate suffices; adding a self-healer there would mask the #81 Change C "essential tests skipped" backstop). The shared poll-loop kernel is byte-equal across build / debug (delimited by `# --- CI-Dispatch Gate shared kernel ---` comments); only the per-site AUTO_ROUTE sourcing legitimately differs (build re-derives `AUTO_ROUTE_SUFFIX` from `LABELS` in-block; debug reuses the in-block var read from `BKIT_AUTO_ROUTE_FILE` before its `rm` — the `rm` is NOT reordered). **D2 invariant preserved** — the gate fires post-final-push ONLY; `worktree-setup` / `create-pr` commits keep `bkit [skip ci]`; zero new mid-build CI triggers (KN-30/§141 cloud-auto-route concurrency intact). **Two companion edge-case guards:** EC-1 pre-flight (`gh pr list --head … --base dev` at build Step 17 entry → existing open PR → Failure Path with named message and `# TODO(#261-ec1)`; probe error → fall through to blind `gh pr create`, no regression); EC-2 abort-guard (build inline Failure Path and shared `.bkit/workflows.md` § Failure Path step 5 → do NOT push a `[skip ci]` abort commit onto a branch with a live PR; probe error → **inverted safe default** = treat as "PR exists, do NOT push"). `.bkit/workflows.md` § "HEAD-Subject Assertion" renamed to § "CI-Dispatch Gate" (string clause RETAINED inside as the pre-push fast-fail); `docs/deployments.md` § "CI trigger on final workflow push" reframed to the outcome gate; KN-11 fix/Related updated to cite the new gate; DE-32 appended with rejected alternatives (3 sites; whole-gate byte-equality; summary: Ship bookkeeping Path A/B with tiered quality carriers — #384
description: Resolved seven findings where `bkit-ship.md`'s push contract was unwritten while it gated merge on a CI-validated PR head — so every head-move race broke a different gate. Restructured the workflow into **verify → base-check → integrate → re-validate → merge-gate → merge → close**. **Path A** (dev not moved): resume the shared worktree read-only — no rebase, no bookkeeping commits, no push — and reuse build's green run. **Path B** (dev moved): B1 `gh pr update-branch` (server-side rebase) or B2 worktree + `@bkit-ship-conflict-resolve` + `git push --force-with-lease`, then **mandatory re-validation** (wait-or-dispatch `ci.yml`, assert the capstone). **One merge gate common to both paths:** `bkit-ship-gate.sh` refuses to merge unless the capstone (`bkit-tests-check`) concluded `success` at the EXACT head being merged — a single assertion strictly stronger than the old Step 3 (which passed a currently-red PR). **Bookkeeping never rides the branch:** `status.jsonl` + ship artifacts target `BOOK_ROOT` (the dev tree, `RUNTIME_DEVPUSHES`-conditional) via a frozen 8-path `BOOK_PATHS` allow-list + outbox durability (`$GIT_COMMON_DIR/bkit-outbox/{FID}/`); the only thing ever pushed to `feat/{FID}` is a Path-B rebase / conflict resolution. **Three tiered quality carriers:** Tier 1 tested `bkit-ship-gate.sh` (9 exit codes incl. cache-skip vs vacuous-skipped distinction, stale-green-at-superseded-head, skipped-lane refusal, `BKIT_SHIP_GATE_OVERRIDE` with audit row); Tier 2 `bkit-ship-invariants.test.ts` (14 canonical `ship-*` step keys + frozen `BOOK_PATHS`, every `status.jsonl` line must carry `BOOK_ROOT`); Tier 3 advisory status-hole detector (parses `bkit-ship.md` for the expected step set — NEVER a parallel table). **Hardened** the Failure Path (`.deferred-blocked` writer now exists; status written to `BOOK_ROOT` not the dev checkout; append ordered after abort), **dropped** the unconditional rebase-on-resume / Step 3 prior-run diffing / Step 8 `Update: Source files.` retry loop, and put `--match-head-commit` on every merge. New config keys `bkit.capstoneJob` / `bkit.ciWorkflow` (consumer-tunable, survive strip); `.husky/pre-push` wired to bats; rendered mirrors regenerated across `.claude/` / `.cursor/` / `.opencode/` / `.bkit/workflows.md`. 2657 vitest + 144 bats (ship-gate 20/20); 10 mutation-verified regression tests. Build challenge: round 1 8 findings (1 CRITICAL — B2 staging `git add -u`) all remediated; round 2 5 concerns (max MEDIUM) non-blocking.

summary: Widen bkit-cloud trigger to post-merge dev CI
description: Closed the post-merge blind spot where a squash-merge that re-reds dev CI reached nobody: the feat/{FID} branch is gone, so no cloud trigger fired. bkit-cloud.yml workflow_run branch filter widens [feat/**] to [feat/**, fix/**, dev]; main stays manual-only. Reuses the existing bkit [auto route] free-tier marker rather than adding a second gate, with /bkit-ship threading it onto the squash-merge subject when the issue carries bkit:auto (materialised via BKIT_AUTO_ROUTE_FILE after the ${LABELS} shell-boundary defect). dev arm recovers the FID from the squash-merge commit scope with a bkit:fid PR-marker fallback, slug-allowlist assert, stale-run guard by CI-run recency, and an exact-match bkit:auto kill-switch re-check. New cross-session loop bound MAX_DEV_DISPATCH_ATTEMPTS=3 counting distinct failed CI SHAs per FID, fail-closed on an unlandable ledger row. fix/** folded into the same budget key. Concurrency flips to cancel-in-progress only for non-dev heads. bkit-auto.md gains CI_DEV mode. Same-repo head_repository trigger gate closes the fork pwn-request path. Shipped docs stripped of internal identifiers, enforced by bkit-shipped-docs-refs.test.ts. 2797 vitest pass; 11 build-challenge findings remediated.

summary: Roadmap ledger, two-tier generated board, fold + cadence + on-demand utility
description: docs/roadmap.jsonl (kind:"feature", six-state ladder DESIGNED|PLANNED|BUILT|DEBUGGED|SHIPPED|ABANDONED) becomes the canonical feature-state ledger, appended at all five phase closes; docs/roadmap.md becomes a consumer-owned two-tier generated board fully regenerated from it (never an upsert), with a deterministic bkit-roadmap-fold.sh status block, an opus @bkit-roadmap-refresh analysis block, and a never-regenerated "## Backlog / Ideas" region. docs/completed.md MIGRATED AND DELETED via the parity-gated bkit telemetry migrate fifth pair plus a bootstrap seed for in-flight FIDs; no fallback reader remains and the completed-md-unmigrated preflight advisory names the command. Adds bkit-roadmap-cadence.sh (fires once per bkit.roadmap.buildCycles distinct BUILT FIDs since the last ROADMAP_CADENCE_FIRE, or bkit.roadmap.stalenessDays elapsed; manifest defaults 10/90), bkit-roadmap-reconcile.sh (read-only drift check warning on a live feat/* with no ledger row), the /bkit-roadmap on-demand utility, MCP-only settled-drift-guarded reverse tracker-label sync, and a build/debug dev-lock ledger write as a fourth staging shape. Sensing is on-disk-first and tracker-additive (list_issues, never search_issues) so the board builds under tracker: none. Ship stages both roadmap paths through the frozen BOOK_PATHS allow-list, and Step 10 DOCS_VERDICT greens only on a SHIPPED-status row. Every roadmap branch exits 0 and never gates a close.
